pieces.doc: Headless aspect-ratio container. Locks the host element's box to a fixed `width / height` ratio via the native CSS `aspect-ratio` property — useful for media (video, image, iframe) and skeletons that must reserve space before content loads.

inputs.name: ratio
inputs.doc: Width / height ratio, e.g. `16 / 9`, `4 / 3`, `1`. Accepts numeric inputs (`[ratio]="16 / 9"`) and string attributes (`ratio="1.5"`). Defaults to `1` (square).
